name: jira
description: Reads and writes the full documented Jira Cloud platform REST API v3 surface: 617 operations across issues, projects, users, fields, workflows, dashboards and instance administration.

risk.read: external Jira Cloud API read of issue, project, and user data
risk.write: external Jira Cloud API mutation across issues, projects, users, fields, workflows, dashboards, and instance administration; 84 of the 292 write actions are DELETEs that permanently remove Jira issues, projects, or instance configuration
risk.approval: required for every write action; reverse ETL plan, preview, approval, execute, and every DELETE action is gated as destructive and additionally requires a typed confirmation; reads are HTTP Basic authenticated with an Atlassian API token
